text.16:7: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.
text.29:13: But they verily will bear their own loads and other loads beside their own, and they verily will be questioned on the Day of Resurrection concerning that which they invented.
text.55:31: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).
text.99:2: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
